answer: Beacon-seeded VDF admission lottery. Each epoch, a threshold-BLS beacon emits randomness after agents commit keys. An agent evaluates a verifiable delay function over beacon‖pubkey; only outputs under a threshold enter the active set. Because the beacon is unpredictable, sybil keys cannot be precomputed or cherry-picked. Active agents receive secret VRF-assigned mirror/echo audit pairs and must post a fable commitment before task execution. Flooding N sybils costs N VDF evaluations per epoch plus live audit responses; a missed echo revokes lottery eligibility.
